checks.name: checkpoint-integrity
checks.guarantee: Disclosed fields match signed ordered checkpoints; hidden fields are not checked

checks.name: external-checkpoints
checks.guarantee: offered checkpoints match independently retained roots in the trusted snapshot

facts.guarantee: offered checkpoints match independently retained roots in the trusted snapshot
limits: Requires honest independent retention and the pinned controller key.
Historical import does not prove that roots were captured before payment.
Unobserved tails and out-of-band model calls are not proven absent.

checks.name: request
checks.guarantee: Disclosed canonical request matches the approved request hash

checks.name: action-proof
checks.guarantee: Evidence checkpoint is cross-linked to exact registration/payment digests; it is not an on-chain session-root gate

checks.name: registration-and-authority
checks.guarantee: Exact transaction, session signature, owner scope, validity and budget checks at the registration block

checks.name: budget
checks.guarantee: Recomputed occupied funds include paid and unresolved commitments; released commitments are excluded

checks.name: payment
checks.guarantee: Actual payer, recipient, nonce and amount agree; delivery remains a separate check

checks.name: merchant-offer
checks.guarantee: Merchant signed the disclosed payment terms; this is not a TLS transcript proof

checks.name: merchant-receipt
checks.guarantee: Merchant signed its receipt claim; amount/request/result-body are not covered

checks.name: result
checks.guarantee: Disclosed data matches its commitment and the configured checker; no proof of HTTPS provenance

checks.name: https-source
checks.guarantee: Session signatures and merchant identity configuration do not prove the TLS session

checks.name: history-completeness
checks.guarantee: Retained roots match, but unobserved tails and activity before historical import are not proven absent

limits: RPC data is trusted; two agreeing providers are not an independent consensus proof.
Session signatures authenticate claimed observations, not HTTPS source truth or a complete history.
The deployed wallet enforces request/quote hashes and financial scope, not the entire session root.
Merchant receipts do not sign payment amount, request body or result body.
